hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"REQUIRED SESSION START to read rules from CLAUDE.md. Show user a summary of this rules"}}'

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'git commit'; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: git commit on master is forbidden. Create a feature branch first (git checkout -b feat/...) and apply the AGENTS.md recovery procedure.'; exit 1; fi; fi
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f && [[ "$f" == *.rs ]] && cargo fmt --quiet --manifest-path "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/Cargo.toml"; } || true
